original_sql:
SELECT o_orderpriority, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM orders
WHERE YEAR(o_orderdate) = 1995
GROUP BY o_orderpriority
ORDER BY o_orderpriority

candidates.sql: SELECT o_orderpriority, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31' GROUP BY o_orderpriority ORDER BY o_orderpriority
candidates.rationale: Using BETWEEN instead of YEAR function can potentially utilize an index on o_orderdate if available.
